a.description: (..., M, M) array_like A complex- or real-valued matrix whose eigenvalues are to be computed.
constraints: shape constraints not specified in docs

UPLO.description: {'L', 'U'}, optional Specifies whether the calculation is done with the lower triangular part of `a` ('L', default) or the upper triangular part ('U'). Irrespective of this value only the real parts of the diagonal will be considered in the computation to preserve the notion of a Hermitian matrix. It therefore follows that the imaginary part of the diagonal will always be treated as zero.
constraints: UPLO must be one of L, U

output.description: ------- (..., M,) ndarray The eigenvalues in ascending order, each repeated according to its multiplicity.
